modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: All cabin bags must be tagged at check-in; if the cabin fills up, bags go in the hold free of charge. Charter flights may differ.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One cabin bag up to 55x40x20 cm, wheels and handles included, in Economy, Comfort Light and Comfort Plus.

personal_item.value: One personal item up to 40×30×15 cm (laptop bag, small handbag, pouch with electronics or one duty-free bag), counted within the total cabin weight.

carryon_weight.value: Total cabin weight: 8 Kg (17 lbs) in Economy and Comfort Light, 15 Kg (33 lbs) in Comfort Plus (13 kg on SATA Air Açores connections).

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Allowance depends on your fare; on trips combining SATA Air Açores and Azores Airlines flights, Azores Airlines rules apply.

allowance_azores_airlines.value: Azores Airlines (S4) by fare: Economy Simple, no checked bag; Basic and Flex, 1 piece of 23 kg (50 lb); Top, 2 pieces totalling 46 kg (100 lb), max 23 kg each. Comfort Light, 2 pieces totalling 46 kg; Comfort Plus, 2 pieces totalling 64 kg (141 lb), max 32 kg (70 lb) each.

allowance_inter_island.value: SATA Air Açores inter-island routes, Economy Class: 23 kg (50 lb).

max_weight.value: Bags over 32 kg (70 lbs) normally travel only as cargo; in listed cases up to 45 kg (100 lbs) is accepted at check-in with fees.
